scope: CAD-bound dielectric tetrahedra and terminal facets; one explicit optimizer; no field solve

payload.encoding: canonical C-order little-endian i8/f8 arrays, exact byte chunks; no pickle or compression

inheritance: CAD options and geometry unchanged; previous explicit-HXT mesh policy, physics, runtime, one-thread allocation and 600/1200/1200-second worker ceilings unchanged
repeatability_rule: exact CAD report, raw/final canonical packets, audit report and effective mesh-policy hashes across fresh local1/repeat1 workers
raw_policy: retain complete raw packet and finite signed quality observations before optimization; positivity is required only for the final audit
